characterList.description: The interviewer, sitting on the left, wearing a white hoodie, a white cap and tinted glasses.
characterList.name: Big Sue

characterList.description: The interviewee, sitting on the right, wearing a blue shirt with white patterns, several rings and a gold watch.
characterList.name: Davido

content_metadata.description: Big Sue interviews Davido about his new album "Timeless," his upcoming tour, and his efforts to promote African culture in America.

qAndA.answer: Suya, a spicy West African street food, is mentioned.
qAndA.question: What food is mentioned as part of the festival experience?

qAndA.answer: He cites a synergy due to his frequent travel between the two cities, implying a cultural exchange.
qAndA.question: Why does Davido think the connection between Atlanta and Lagos is special?
What is the full form of "A.W.A.Y. Fest"?

qAndA.answer: He wants to educate Americans about the true nature of Africa and provide opportunities for African artists to gain exposure.
qAndA.question: Why is Davido focusing on promoting African culture in America?

qAndA.answer: "Unavailable" challenge. It is evident from the on-screen graphic that reads "Unavailable" and Davido's comment, "So we did it, posted it on the gram, went crazy boom."
qAndA.question: What is the name of the dance challenge associated with Davido's new single?

activities.description: Big Sue introduces Davido and mentions their frequent encounters at airports. Davido chuckles and comments on always being on the move.

characterInteraction.description: Big Sue and Davido engage in a friendly banter about their encounters at the airport.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Establishes the rapport and frequent meetings between Big Sue and Davido.

mood.description: Happy - Both individuals are smiling and seem genuinely happy to see each other.

narrativeProgression.description: Big Sue introduces Davido and mentions their connection through trapping.
Big Sue jokes about not seeing Davido for a while and points out their frequent airport encounters.
Davido agrees and jokingly says, "You always be movin', man."
Davido confirms he has to catch a flight soon.

scenes.title: Introduction and Airport Encounters

activities.description: Davido reveals his travel plans, discusses his new album "Timeless", highlighting its success and breaking records.

characterInteraction.description: Big Sue asks questions, and Davido talks about the success of his new album, showcasing a strong sense of accomplishment and pride.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Highlights Davido's current projects and success in the music industry.

mood.description: Proud - Davido talks about his accomplishments with a proud and confident demeanor.

narrativeProgression.description: Big Sue asks about Davido's upcoming travel plans.
Davido says he's going to Miami, then L.A for promo work.
Big Sue mentions Davido's new album "Timeless."
Big Sue and Davido exchange comments about the album reaching #1.
Big Sue asks about the album's performance in terms of numbers.
Davido describes breaking records on Spotify, Apple Music and being the biggest Afrobeat debut ever.
Davido mentions how special this album is to him, especially after taking a long break.

scenes.thematicElements: Discussion on travel plans and musical success of the new album
scenes.title: Davido's Travel Plans and Album Success

activities.description: Big Sue and Davido discuss the upcoming “Timeless Tour” and the festival “A.W.A.Y. Fest,” sharing the meaning behind “A.W.A.Y.” Davido talks about educating Americans about Africa and the success of his new single "Unavailable."

characterInteraction.description: Big Sue asks guiding questions, letting Davido lead the conversation. Davido shows passion and conviction while discussing his tour, festival and the importance of representing African culture.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Sheds light on Davido's efforts to promote African culture through his tour and festival.

mood.description: Excited - Both individuals express enthusiasm about the upcoming tour and festival, especially the potential to share African culture.

narrativeProgression.description: Big Sue brings up the "Timeless Tour."
Big Sue jokes about moving up to stadium venues for the tour.
Big Sue asks Davido to describe the tour.
Davido mentions starting the tour in D.C. and ending in Atlanta.
Davido announces starting a festival called “A.W.A.Y. Fest” on November 18th.
Davido expresses a desire to create an African Coachella and describes the special connection between Atlanta and Lagos.
Davido explains his decision to start an African festival.
Davido emphasizes the lack of opportunities for African artists to perform in America.
Davido shares an anecdote about playing Nigerian music in an American club and receiving positive feedback.
Big Sue suggests adding food vendors to the festival.
Big Sue expresses his interest in trying West African food.
Davido confirms including food and fashion elements at the festival.
Big Sue confirms the festival date as November 18th and asks for the festival's name.
Davido reveals the festival's name as “A.W.A.Y. Fest” and explains its meaning: "Are We African Yet?"
Davido talks about the current trend of exploring one's African roots and mentions Drake's recent journey.
Davido positions his festival as a step toward showcasing Africa to a wider audience.
Davido emphasizes educating people about the reality of Africa.
Big Sue recaps the album and the new single “Unavailable.”
Big Sue prompts Davido to talk about his new single.
Davido expresses his desire to have a viral record on each album and shares the process behind “Unavailable.”
Davido talks about posting the “Unavailable” dance challenge on Instagram and its rapid success.

scenes.thematicElements: Timeless Tour, A.W.A.Y. Fest, African culture promotion and viral single success.
scenes.title: Timeless Tour and African Culture Promotion

climax.description: The interview reaches its climax when Davido proudly discusses his album's success and his motivation for creating an African festival in America.
